Using Destiny Fruits during exploration does more than summon Molly. It also unearths ancient Relics hidden within the region. Check the Relic Set to track missing pieces and pinpoint their exact locations for a final sweep!

Not sure what Relics are in the region? Check the nearest Goddess Statue for a full list.

[[File:Destiny Fruits.png|center]]
Destiny Exploration may summon Molly or the Mysterious Merchant to your Home. Prioritize high-discount items—but beware, some deals may not be what they seem!
